content:
Lucy H: Heads up — crossdock holdlist flagged 3 cards from the same manifest (MAN-4928) with intermittent Xid/ECC warnings during soak. Putting them on hold until we confirm serials and RMA path.

Omar: Which racks/region?

Lucy H: eu-west-2 rack 12 (2 cards), and uk-lon rack 3 (1 card). Spare pool nearest is LON-spare-3.

Kai: Any kernel logs or nvidia-smi output?

Lucy H: Quick paste from kernel logs on one host:
```
[ 12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:03:00): 31, pid=2042, GPU 0: 0x000c1008
[ 12346.000123] nvidia: GPU 0000:03:00.0: ECC error, corrected (2)
```

Marta: That 31/Xid pattern matches the flaky memory lane we saw in March. Serial pattern for the 3 cards: GPN-7X1-****-B12, GPN-7X1-****-B13, GPN-7X1-****-C01 (obfuscated).

Dmitri: Are these in the same vendor batch? Vendor shows ACCELPARTS batch AP-21-07 in the manifest.

Lucy H: Yes, manifest points to ACCELPARTS AP-21-07. I already opened ACC-78934 with them. They want full serials + BOL + images.

EngOpsBot: auto-tag: holdlist_added MAN-4928; assignees: @Lucy H, @Omar; priority: P2

Omar: Logistics questions — do we want depot swap (vendor exchange) or local swap using LON-spare-3? Customer SLAs might be impacted for a few jobs in eu-west cluster.

Marta: For the two eu-west cards, LON-spare-3 can cover immediate swaps but we need serial reconciliation to avoid customs trouble on the vendor return. If we do depot swap, ACCELPARTS requires manifest + customs declaration.

Lucy H: Proposed plan: 1) Hot-swap the eu-west hosts with LON-spare-3 to restore capacity. 2) Tag the failed cards, take high-res photos, gather serials and BOL. 3) Ship to ACCELPARTS crossdock depot (UK) as depot-exchange under ACC-78934. 4) Track via courier with exported manifest to avoid hold at customs.

Kai: Sounds good. For the interim replacement, can we keep VM allocations pinned to avoid noisy scaling?

Dmitri: Also confirm whether Dedicated auto-drain hooks are firing — might be repeated drains causing Xid. Any pattern in load?

Lucy H: Load was steady — synthetic microbench runs ~75% util. No obvious thermal throttle in logs.

Omar: Who's on booking for courier? Last time DHL Pro was quickest for UK <-> EU crossdock. ETA 48-72h if same-day pickup. Do we have customs EORI docs on file for ACCELPARTS?

Marta: ACCELPARTS uses broker QuickClear — they requested pack-level manifest and serial mapping. I'll attach images and paperwork to ACC-78934.

EngOpsBot: ticket ACC-78934 updated by Marta: added photos + manifest draft.

VendorAccelPartsBot: ACCELPARTS: Received claim ACC-78934. Preliminary review shows potential microfracture on connector on one card. Requesting RMA approval. Please include full serials and invoice copy.

Kai: Can we do an internal retain-for-analysis tag on one card? We'll want to GPU-swap live for two, keep one for extended oscilloscope/thermal run.

Lucy H: Yes — plan to retain the uk-lon card (serial GPN-7X1-0000-C01) for in-house repro and ship the two eu-west cards to vendor.

Omar: What's the spare pool balance after taking LON-spare-3 parts?

Marta: Post-swap spare counts: LON-spare-3 will go down by 2, remaining 1 in LON pool. EU-central spare pool has 0 compatible units. Reorder threshold hit.

Dmitri: If eu-central hits zero, we should consider short-term borrowing from onprem partner DC in FRA. Otherwise risk capacity throttles for Dedicated customers.

Lucy H: I'll start an internal purchase request for 6 units (quant 6) and mark it rush. Also flag Dedicated customers for potential capacity SLO impact in the next 72h.

Omar: Logistics checklist before shipping:
- Confirm full serials and photos (Marta)
- Export BOL + invoice (Lucy)
- Create shipment label with DHL Pro and QuickClear broker (Omar)
- Update ACC-78934 with AWB and ETA (Marta)

Marta: Done for photos. Lucy can you paste full serials when you tag the units?

Lucy H: Pasted full serials in ACC-78934 (privately): GPN-7X1-1122-B12, GPN-7X1-1122-B13, GPN-7X1-1122-C01.

VendorAccelPartsBot: ACCELPARTS: RMA approved pending receipt. Ship to DEPOT-UK-CROSS-01. Please include ACC-78934 on paperwork.

EngOpsBot: status update: MAN-4928 -> HOLD -> awaiting shipment docs.

Omar: One more ask — add a note to the manifest that two cards are 'exchange under warranty' and one is 'retain for analysis'. Customs flagged similar cases before.

Marta: Added that note to the manifest draft.

Dmitri: After swap, let's run 48h soak with continuous ECC monitoring and enable verbose kernel logging. If Xid recurs on the replacement units, escalate to HW team and stop shipments.

Lucy H: Will do. I'll kick off the swaps at 09:30 UTC tomorrow and update thread with AWB once the courier picks up.

Kai: Thx team. :thumbsup:

Lucy H: tagging @oncall-eng-infra FYI for any emergent capacity issues during swap window.

EngOpsBot: alert created for swap window 09:30-12:00 UTC; oncall paged.

Marta: AWB created: DHLPRO-UK123456789. ETA depot receipt 202.03.1987 (placeholder ETA format) — updating ACC-78934 now.

Omar: Closing loop — once depot confirms receipt, we'll close holdlist and reconcile serials in inventory.

Lucy H: Thanks all — keeping this thread live for any updates.
